title: Bilateral stance-force shape distance does not establish added cross-dataset Parkinson discrimination
abstract: Bilateral normalized stance-force shape distance did not establish added Parkinson discrimination in exploratory NDD-to-PDB transfer beyond gait timing, coordination and force-shape summaries/asymmetries. In 163 target people, baseline/augmented log loss was 0.629665/0.629871; paired gain -0.000206, conditional95% interval [-0.001821, 0.001415]; AUC 0.740661/0.745560. Joint-refit intervals include zero in both directions. An age>=50 sensitivity is conditionally favorable but is not untouched confirmation. This is a model/detector-specific negative primary result, not equivalence.
